features.title: How to use USB DFU protocol in bootloader on STM32 MCUs Introduction This application note describes the USB DFU protocol used in STM32 microcontroller

caption: Table 2. DFU class requests
rows: Requests the device to leave DFU mode and enter the application.
Requests data transfer from Host to the device in order to load them into device internal flash memory. Includes also erase commands.
Requests data transfer from device to Host in order to load content of device internal flash memory into a Host file.
Requests device to send status report to the Host (including status resulting from the last request execution and the state the device enters immediately after this request).
Requests device to clear error status and move to next step.
Requests the device to send only the state it enters immediately after this request.
Requests device to exit the current state/operation and enter idle state immediately.

caption: Table 5. Bootloader protocol versions
rows: DFU Bootloader version V2.1. Unlike version V2.0, this version features an extended interface descriptor including OTP memory interface and device feature interface. V2.0 and V2.1 are implemented on different devices. Refer to AN2606 to know the version implemented on the used device. Fixed bug found when writing in data memory timing by using an adequate timeout.
Updated option bytes, OTP and device feature descriptors to support only Read/Write operation instead of Read/Write/Erase.
The number of command can vary on devices with the same protocol version v3.0. To know supported commands, use Get command.
